definitions.explanation: exercising power in a selfish and arbitrary manner, ignoring others' rights or proper procedures

examples.japanese: {専横|せんおう}な{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}いを{許|ゆる}さない。
examples.english: We will not tolerate arrogant behavior.

examples.japanese: {権力|けんりょく}を{握|にぎ}ると{専横|せんおう}になりやすい。
examples.english: One tends to become despotic when holding power.

examples.japanese: {専横|せんおう}な{政治|せいじ}に{対|たい}する{批判|ひはん}が{高|たか}まった。
{上司|じょうし}の{専横|せんおう}ぶりに{部下|ぶか}たちは{不満|ふまん}を{募|つの}らせている。
examples.english: The subordinates are growing frustrated with their boss's arbitrariness.

notes:
{専横|せんおう} describes the abuse of power in an arbitrary, selfish manner, ignoring proper procedures or others' rights.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {専|せん} (exclusive, solely, monopolize)
- {横|おう} (sideways; unreasonable, arbitrary)

GRAMMAR:
- Used as noun: {専横|せんおう}を{許|ゆる}さない (not allow despotism)
- Used as na-adjective: {専横|せんおう}な{人|ひと} (a despotic person)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {専横|せんおう}を{極|きわ}める (to be extremely despotic)
- {専横|せんおう}に{走|はし}る (to become despotic)
- {専横|せんおう}な{支配|しはい} (despotic rule)

NUANCE:
- Stronger and more formal than {横暴|おうぼう}
- Often used in political/historical contexts
- Implies abuse of power and disregard for others

SIMILAR TERMS:
- {横暴|おうぼう} - tyranny, high-handedness
- {独断|どくだん} - arbitrary decision
- {独善|どくぜん} - self-righteousness

RELATED TERMS:
- {横暴|おうぼう} (tyranny)
- {独裁|どくさい} (dictatorship)
- {暴君|ぼうくん} (tyrant)
- {傲慢|ごうまん} (arrogance)
